commissioner_election.note: IC 36-2-2-4(c) (GOV-125): a county of 185,000-300,000 that opts in elects each commissioner from a single-member district; St. Joseph County opted in by Resolution R-16-C-2023 (July 11, 2023, GOV-127), the same record as council_size and legislative_power. Subject to the pending appeal 26S-PL-00156. Commissioners are elected by district (2024 and 2026 canvasses). In Outlaw et al. v. State of Indiana Election Commission (Marion Superior Court 11, 49D11-2302-PL-005795) the court entered final judgment on April 14, 2026 (amended April 21) on challenges to IC 36-2-2-4, 36-2-2-5, 36-2-3-2 and 36-2-3-4; the Election Commission and other defendants appealed to the Indiana Supreme Court (26S-PL-00156), fully briefed October 2, 2026 and pending. The order text is not public on MyCase; news reports describe its scope.

council_size.note: IC 36-2-3-4(c) (GOV-124): a county of 185,000-300,000 that opts in under IC 36-2-2-4(c) has nine single-member council districts, three inside each commissioner district. St. Joseph County (272,912 in the 2020 Census) opted in: the Board of Commissioners adopted Resolution R-16-C-2023 on July 11, 2023, 3-0 (GOV-127), before the Sept 1, 2023 deadline (GOV-125). These provisions are among those challenged in 49D11-2302-PL-005795 (final judgment Apr 14, 2026; appeal 26S-PL-00156 pending).

legislative_power.note: IC 36-2-3.5-3: in covered counties the council is the legislative and fiscal body. IC 36-2-3.5-1(2) covers counties of 185,000-300,000 that opt in under IC 36-2-2-4(c); St. Joseph opted in by Resolution R-16-C-2023 (July 11, 2023, GOV-127). Subject to the pending appeal 26S-PL-00156.
